ValidationRule.description: A cross-sell opportunity can only be exhausted by a System Administrator.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: And( OR(ISPICKVAL( Type , "Cross-sell"),ISPICKVAL( Type, "Upsell")), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Exhausted"), NOT($Profile.Id = "00e1a000000lWln") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This opportunity can only be exhausted by BI.
